summary: M26 Phase E · Notifications & Reminders end-to-end tested. Backend: new /app/backend/tests/test_m26_phase_e.py — 8/8 pytest pass covering (1) sync_participants_from_pools fires one 'Invited to <tournament>' notification per newly-added body (recipient_role_id=division-secretary, recipient_body_id=<body_code>, related_type='tournament_participation', severity='warning') and does NOT re-fire when a soft-deleted body reappears in the pools, (2) brand-new body added to an existing pool DOES fire a fresh notification, (3) PATCH /participants/{code} with acceptance_status='Accepted' creates one MPCA notification (recipient_role_id='secretary', recipient_body_id='MPCA', severity='info', message contains 'accepted') and 'Declined' creates one severity='warning' with message containing 'declined', (4) GET /participation-reminders returns the documented shape {reminder_count, reminders:[{body_code, body_name, body_type, role, acceptance_status, outstanding_inr, reasons[]}]} — DIV-BPL on MY Memorial shows 'unsettled' with outstanding=49560, (5) a fresh test tournament with end_date in the past, a backdated Pending row (>7d) and an Accepted-no-budget row correctly emits reasons ['awaiting_acceptance','no_claim_after_end'] and ['no_budget','no_claim_after_end'] respectively, (6) 404 on unknown tid for both GET & POST endpoints, (7) POST /participation-reminders/dispatch returns {dispatched_count, reminder_count}, fires a notification titled 'Outstanding balance · Bhopal Division' to recipient_role_id='secretary'/MPCA (unsettled reason routes to MPCA, other reasons to the body's own secretary — verified via _notify_participation path), (8) dispatch is intentionally idempotent — a second call fires the same batch again (dispatched_count identical, notification count doubles). Regression: 39/39 Phase A/B/C/D pytest (test_m26_participants_matrix.py + test_m26_phase_b.py + test_m26_phase_c.py + test_m26_phase_d.py) still green. Frontend UI test on tournament e2a9ac5c-8e72-4d0a-9aa9-8dae40f482e5 as MPCA Secretary (persona-chip-secretary): Overview → box-participants opens the Multi-Division Ledger panel. `data-testid=participants-reminders-summary` renders below the readiness badge and above the table with '1 Lifecycle Reminder(s)' + 'Bhopal Division (Visitor) · unsettled · ₹49,560' (matches spec verbatim). `data-testid=participants-reminders-btn` visible in header with text 'Reminders (1)', brass BellRing icon, not disabled. Click → observed POST /api/tournaments/{tid}/participation-reminders/dispatch returning 200 with body {dispatched_count:1, reminder_count:1}. Panel updates to show '✓ 1 dispatched' inline next to the count. Verified in db.notifications a fresh document exists with recipient_role_id='secretary', recipient_body_id='MPCA', related_type='tournament_participation', title='Outstanding balance · Bhopal Division', severity='info'. Phase D regression: NEFT modal (participants-neft-btn) still opens on the same page, all testids present (neft-modal-backdrop, neft-modal, neft-row-DIV-BPL, neft-check-DIV-BPL, neft-export-btn, neft-cancel-btn). Bank/IFSC + outstanding ₹49,560 render correctly. Cleaned up 1 dispatched-during-UI-test notification post-test to keep the state pristine for main agent.
critical_code_review_comments: sync_participants_from_pools · The newly_added detection is based on `existing = find_one(...)` returning None. If a row exists but is soft-deleted (removed_at != None), it is NOT added to newly_added — good, this correctly matches spec 'reappearing bodies do not re-notify'. However this also means a body that was previously ONLY a match-official and got upgraded to a participant row via a different code path would silently skip the invite. Low-risk today since all participant rows enter via this function.

_notify_participation and _notify_mpca both wrap _create_notification in a bare `except Exception: pass`. This swallows all errors including invalid role_id / model validation. Consider at least logging via `logging.exception` so ops can see delivery failures.

dispatch_participation_reminders is documented as idempotent-but-repeatable — a repeat call inserts DUPLICATE notifications rather than upserting. For a Treasurer double-clicking the Reminders button this creates noise in the notifications inbox. Consider either (a) a client-side confirm modal, (b) throttle at server (skip if a same-title notification exists <10min old for that reminder), or (c) button UI disables for 30s after dispatch. Currently the UI does re-enable immediately after the loader clears.

participation_reminders `awaiting_acceptance` uses (now - created_at).days which is integer days — a Pending row created 6d 23h 59m ago will still return 6 and NOT flag. Consider float days (total_seconds() / 86400) if 7d exact semantics matter.

participation_reminders end_date comparison: `end_date` is parsed as YYYY-MM-DD which becomes 00:00 UTC. A tournament ending today will already have `now > end_date` at 00:00:01 UTC — 'no_claim_after_end' can fire on the last day. Cosmetic; consider adding a 24h grace window.

dispatch_participation_reminders does not include a per-body dedup — a body with 3 reasons gets 3 separate notifications, some to MPCA and some to the body-secretary. This is spec-compliant but visually noisy. Consider a compact single-notification-with-reasons-list variant for future.

ParticipantsMatrix.jsx line 108 mutates `reminders._last_dispatched` via functional setState which is fine, but the field name collides with API-shape (leading underscore). Non-blocking; UI code owns this.
Frontend load() catches errors on `/participation-reminders` silently — no visible error state if the endpoint 500s. Consider surfacing failures in the err bar for observability.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests are self-cleaning — every scratch tournament + participation rows + notifications are deleted in a try/finally. An autouse fixture removes NEFT_Batch receipts on the MY Memorial fixture tournament before + after each test so DIV-BPL outstanding_inr stays at 49560. Frontend UI test dispatched one 'Outstanding balance · Bhopal Division' notification during the click flow; explicitly deleted post-test so the notifications collection stays clean for future QA. Bhopal Division 'Chambal Division accepted' notification from an earlier iteration is unrelated (from Phase B testing) and left in place.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase E green. test_m26_phase_e.py is the regression harness — critically uses tournament fixture MY_MEMORIAL_TID=e2a9ac5c and DIV_BPL to exercise the 'unsettled' path since DIV-BPL currently has an approved claim of ₹49,560 without a receipt. If a future phase adds an auto-receipt for BPL, the reminders test must switch to a synthetic tournament. Two nice-to-haves flagged for main agent (non-blocking): (1) server-side dedup / throttle on dispatch endpoint to prevent duplicate notification spam, (2) surface reminders-load errors in the UI err bar. Frontend load() fetches /participation-reminders in parallel with participants+readiness — no ordering issues observed. Note: /api/tournaments creation requires `format` (T20/One_Day/Multi_Day/…) — future tests should include it. `setup-meta` PATCH expects body {'setup_meta': {...}} not the raw pools object.
